title: Insider's Identity
source_topic: ICPC / The 2018 Asia Hanoi Regional Contest
statement: A pattern of at most thirty characters, each either a one or a wildcard and at least half of them ones, marks a binary string of length n as valid when some substring of the string matches the pattern position by position, with wildcards matching either bit. The task counts how many distinct valid strings of length n exist, where n is at most fifty.
